definitions.explanation: The act of resisting or opposing authority, rules, or established norms.

examples.english: There's a period of rebelling against parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不当|ふとう}→不当：11319_futou⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反抗|はんこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{反抗|はんこう}{期|き}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Children in their rebellious phase are difficult to handle.
examples.notes: ⟦{反抗|はんこう}{期|き}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧ = rebellious period

notes:
USAGE: {反抗|はんこう} refers to opposing or resisting authority. It's commonly used when discussing adolescent rebellion or resistance to rules.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {反抗|はんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to rebel, to resist)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反抗|はんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to rebel against ~)
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}{的|てき}→反抗的：21089_hankouteki⟧ (rebellious, defiant)
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}{心|しん}→反抗心：28192_hankoushin⟧ (rebellious spirit)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}{期|き}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧ (rebellious phase/period - esp. adolescence)
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}{心|しん}→反抗心：28192_hankoushin⟧ (spirit of rebellion)
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}{的|てき}→反抗的：21089_hankouteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (defiant attitude)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧ - resistance (physical or metaphorical)
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧ - opposition (to an idea/plan)
- ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ - opposition, backlash
